title: Shinonome Ena — Evident Emotion & Effort〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Main Street
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I'm glad I decided to leave a little early. I wouldn't have found these cute clothes if I hadn't.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, I should start making my way over to school and... Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That looks like...

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry...
But thank you very much for helping me look for it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
I don't have any plans after this, so...
se_walk_women_001_3

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What's wrong, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, Ena...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: This lady lost the lucky charm that her grandchildren gave her. I was just helping her look for it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Can you tell me what your charm looks like, ma'am?

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: It's white with an embroidered design, and it's supposed to bring good health. I had it attached to my wallet, but it looks like the string snapped.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Your wallet...?

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: I was browsing around that shop just over there. Then, when I moved to a different shop, I noticed that it was gone when I went up to the register.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: Which is why I thought that I'd dropped it somewhere around this shop...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What if someone picked it up and took it over to the police station...?

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: I suppose that's a possibility. I think I'll go over and ask.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, before you do...
Have you looked inside your bag for it?

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: A long time ago, I also lost a charm that was attached to my wallet...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I remember looking all over for it as well. Then, I decided to take a stab in the dark by searching my bag. And it was there.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I think it got stuck underneath some of my textbooks. My guess was that the string broke after I yanked my wallet out of my bag.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: I see. Now that you mention it, I haven't actually looked inside my bag yet.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then, I'll hold it while you look.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line:
Oh...
Wow...! Here it is!

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line:
It was in my bag this whole time...!
Now I feel terrible about making you two look for it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, we're just glad that you were able to find it since it means so much to you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Thank you, Ena.
We wouldn't have been able to find it without you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? Uhh... Y-You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line:
Thank you so much.
Now, if you'll excuse me.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, please stay safe.
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Phew... Thank goodness we were able to find it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I didn't know that you used to carry a charm around.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: My mom gave it to me a long time ago.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I mean, we all have our prayers and wishes. Like wanting to get into a particular school.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But that didn't go as planned...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Should I have not said anything?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No. Again, it's all ancient history now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: More importantly, Mafuyu, did you not bring an umbrella?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Huh? An umbrella?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: There's a seventy percent chance for rain this evening. Just look at those clouds over there. They look pitch black.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Here, I'll lend you my fold-up umbrella.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's okay since it hasn't started raining yet.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, it's not.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You were under the weather just the other day. Also, if you caught a cold or something, Kanade's gonna be worried sick.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But what will you do, Ena...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'll use the umbrella I keep at school.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then, if you don't mind.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Nope. Take it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Anyway, I gotta go to school.
See you on Nightcord later!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Okay...
Stay safe.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You too.
